kind: CPU only; no renderer, no GPU
continuityCriterion: C0 position/orientation continuity; epsilon convergence separates a finite jump from finite track velocity. Linear slerp keys do not imply C1 continuity.
contactCriterion: Finite physical blade segment intersects actual skinned enemy head/shoulder or torso triangles or corresponding actual vertex AABB. High-step test uses supplied production positions; same-ground test changes only hero Y. Actor-forward direction is diagnostic, not a hit criterion.
